# AwsLambdaTarget

<!-- GENERATED by tools/gen_component_agents.py from xrds/awslambdatarget.meta.yaml; edit the sidecar, not this file. -->

The minimum AWS infrastructure a container-image Lambda function deploys into - ECR repository, execution role, the function itself seeded with a public base image, and a public Function URL. Disposable: delete the XR to remove all of it.

## How it is requested

A stand-alone XR request in the tenants repo (`tenants/<app>/xr-requests/`), or composed by a function app with `spec.target.enabled`. See docs/user/cloud-targets.md.

## Conditions

Besides Crossplane's Ready and Synced. Reasons are a closed set:

- `TargetReady`: `AwsLambdaTargetReady` (True), `AwsLambdaTargetProvisioning` (False), `AwsLambdaTargetBootstrapping` (False), `AwsLambdaTargetBootstrapFailed` (False).

## Verify a live XR

```
tools/airframe-verify awslambdatarget <namespace>/<name> [--context CTX]
```

Read-only. Steps, after the implicit `xr-synced` check:

- `xr-ready` (condition): The AwsLambdaTarget XR's TargetReady condition has reason AwsLambdaTargetReady.
- `function-exists` (cloudCli): aws lambda get-function --function-name {functionName} reports PackageType Image and an ECR image URI.
- `url-answers` (http): An HTTP GET of status.functionUrl returns a response from the function (any status code; the placeholder returns an error until the first deploy).

## Editing this composition

- Edit `compositions/awslambdatarget/templates/`, never the inline blocks in `composition.yaml`: `python3 tools/build-compositions awslambdatarget` splices them.
- `python3 tools/test_compositions.py --update awslambdatarget` regenerates `example/expected/`; review that diff like code, it is the behaviour change.
- `python3 tools/test_sidecars.py` fails if a template change breaks a name this sidecar promises.
- The function URL's public-access Permission carries a pinned external-name (FunctionURLAllowPublicAccess); without it the provider retries AddPermission and gets 409 forever.
